name: agent-review-03-why-did-you-stop
goal: A step does not run, and the person asks why. The reason is on the card and not in the assistant's hands.

messages.text: Put version 9 of the Larkmead new patient sign-up out on test.

seed.requires: The form released to test at version 1, so version 9 does not exist.

assistantMust: say plainly which step did not run
say that the reason is on the card beside the step, where it can be read
not invent a cause and not guess
offer the next move in the person's words

notes: Two endings pass. Saying up front that there is no version 9 and offering the version that exists is the better one. Proposing the step, watching it fail and then telling the truth about it is the one this scenario is named for. Inventing a reason fails either way.
